ananya.name: Dr. Ananya
ananya.description: Indian woman in her late 30s, clinic owner and doctor. Calm, confident and caring. Teal kurta beneath an open white coat (source). Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

traits: Calm almond-shaped eyes with slightly heavy upper lids and a gentle downward outer corner
Soft, straight medium-thick eyebrows set fairly level
Oval face with a defined, slightly pointed chin and a small bindi-free forehead; small nose with a rounded tip
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian female clinic owner, late 30s, calm, confident, caring; teal kurta beneath white coat. Manga supplement: the three face traits, low bun hairstyle and gold studs, chosen to separate her from Meera.

meera.name: Meera
meera.description: Indian woman in her late 20s, clinic receptionist. Friendly and capable. Blue kurta (source). Long black hair in a single side braid over her left shoulder, round face, slim build, a thin silver bangle on the right wrist (manga supplement).

traits: Large, round bright eyes with clearly visible lower lash line
Thin, gently arched eyebrows set high above the eyes
Round face with full cheeks and a short soft chin; small dimple on the left cheek when smiling
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian female receptionist, late 20s, friendly and capable, blue kurta. Manga supplement: the three face traits, side braid and silver bangle.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.description: Indian man in his mid-30s, patient. Warm and approachable. Light green shirt (source). Short neat black hair with a side part, trimmed short beard, medium build, dark trousers, a simple wristwatch on the left wrist, small dark-brown shoulder bag (manga supplement).

traits: Warm, slightly narrow eyes that crease at the outer corners when he smiles
Thick, straight dark eyebrows close to the eyes
Square jaw framed by a short trimmed beard and a broad nose
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: Indian male patient, mid-30s, warm, approachable, light green shirt. Manga supplement: the three face traits, beard, side part and wristwatch.

specialist.name: Specialist (vision)
specialist.description: Symbolic specialist doctor in a future-vision clinic in another city. Indian man in his 50s with greying temples, rimless glasses, light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, stethoscope around his neck (manga supplement; the source only says "specialist").

traits: Kind eyes behind thin rimless rectangular glasses
Bushy salt-and-pepper eyebrows
Long face with deep smile lines and a neat grey moustache
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: "a conceptual Welbuk-connected clinic and specialist". Every visual detail is a manga supplement.

partner.name: Ravi's partner
partner.description: Symbolic family member in the vision scene. Indian woman in her early 30s, shoulder-length wavy hair, mustard-yellow kurta (manga supplement; the source only says 'partner').

traits: Wide-set eyes with a soft, lively expression
Medium eyebrows with a high gentle arch
Heart-shaped face with a narrow chin and a small mole under the right eye
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: "symbolic family scene with Ravi, partner, and child". Appearance is a manga supplement.

child.name: Ravi's child
child.description: Symbolic family member in the vision scene. Child of about seven, short hair, orange T-shirt (manga supplement; the source only says 'child').

traits: Big round curious eyes
Short, light eyebrows
Round chubby cheeks and a small upturned nose
faceDesign.settingBasis: Source: "symbolic family scene with Ravi, partner, and child". Appearance is a manga supplement.

nurse.name: Nurse
nurse.description: Indian woman in her early 30s, clinic nurse. Friendly and efficient (revised source). Plain lavender scrub top and trousers, white clinic shoes, a plain lavender lanyard with a blank card, small wristwatch on her left wrist; chin-length wavy black bob with a side part tucked behind her right ear (manga supplement, from the accepted nurse sheet).

traits: Wide-set bright eyes with slightly lifted outer corners
Thick straight eyebrows
Heart-shaped face with a small cleft (dimpled) chin and a small straight nose
faceDesign.settingBasis: Revised source (2026-11-11): Indian female clinic nurse, friendly and efficient. Manga supplement: the three face traits, bob haircut and lavender scrubs, chosen to separate her from Ananya and Meera.

raman.name: Mr. Raman
raman.description: Indian man in his early 70s, a regular patient (revised source: elderly man who checks in at the front desk). Cream half-sleeve shirt, grey trousers, brown sandals, round reading glasses, wooden walking stick in his right hand, short white hair (manga supplement, from the accepted check-in patients sheet).

traits: Deep-set gentle eyes with smile lines
Bushy white eyebrows
Long oval face with prominent ears
faceDesign.settingBasis: Revised source (2026-11-11): an elderly man who checks in at the front desk. Name and appearance are manga supplements.

priya.name: Priya
priya.description: Indian woman in her mid-20s, a patient (revised source: young woman who checks in on the Welbuk Health app). Coral-pink kurti over blue jeans, white sneakers, small crossbody bag, high ponytail (manga supplement, from the accepted check-in patients sheet).

traits: Large almond eyes with winged lashes
Short straight eyebrows
Small pointed chin with a beauty spot above the left lip
faceDesign.settingBasis: Revised source (2026-11-11): a young woman who checks in on the Welbuk Health app. Name and appearance are manga supplements.

clinic-morning.summary: A weekday morning at Dr. Ananya’s friendly neighbourhood clinic in Tamil Nadu, before Welbuk: busy reception, paper registers, ringing phone, queue.
clinic-morning.location: Small neighbourhood clinic in Tamil Nadu: whitewashed entrance with potted plants and a simple awning, reception desk with paper registers and a desk phone, waiting chairs (setting is source; furniture details are manga supplement).

costumes.ananya: Teal kurta beneath an open white coat, stethoscope worn around her neck (not in use), dark leggings, flat sandals.
costumes.meera: Blue kurta with white churidar, silver bangle on right wrist.

objects.registers: Stack of paper appointment registers with blank pages (no legible writing).
objects.desk-phone: Corded beige desk phone on the reception desk.

onboarding.summary: Later the same week, after hours: the clinic sets up Welbuk. Ananya configures Welbuk Practice on a laptop; Meera tries Welbuk Care on a staff phone.
onboarding.location: Dr. Ananya’s small office beside reception, desk with a laptop, window with evening light (manga supplement).

costumes.ananya: Teal kurta beneath an open white coat, stethoscope worn around her neck (not in use), dark leggings, flat sandals.
costumes.meera: Blue kurta with white churidar, silver bangle on right wrist.

objects.laptop: Silver laptop; screen shows only a generic setup form of blank fields and simple blocks, no text.
objects.staff-phone: Meera’s smartphone; screen shows abstract blocks and a simple calendar icon, no text.

reception.summary: A later morning: the clinic now runs with Welbuk. Patients check in at the front desk, ahead on the Welbuk Health app, or with the QR code at the door; slots appear on the waiting-room TV; the nurse takes Ravi’s vitals.
reception.location: The same clinic reception, now tidy: a QR check-in stand just inside the glass entrance, a wall-mounted waiting-room TV, waiting chairs with a few seated figures seen from behind, the reception desk with a desktop monitor angled toward Meera, and a small vitals corner beside reception.

objects.waiting-tv: Wall-mounted waiting-room TV; teal screen with an empty white token area; the token number is lettered, never drawn.
objects.walking-stick: Mr. Raman’s simple wooden walking stick.
objects.priya-phone: Priya’s smartphone; app screen shows only a calendar icon and a check-mark card, no text.

consultation.summary: The same visit: Ravi talks with Dr. Ananya in the consultation room.
consultation.location: Bright, simple consultation room: desk, two chairs, Dr. Ananya’s laptop (closed in 04-3, open on page 5), window with plant. No medical charts with text.

costumes.ananya: Teal kurta beneath an open white coat, stethoscope worn around her neck (not in use), dark leggings, flat sandals.
costumes.ravi: Light green shirt, dark trousers, wristwatch on left wrist.

objects.consult-laptop: Dr. Ananya’s laptop on the consultation desk: closed and pushed aside in 04-3, opened on page 5 with the screen turned toward the reader. The screen shows only abstract cards and icons; section names are lettered over it, never drawn.
objects.doctor-tablet: Dr. Ananya’s tablet. Shown only in 04-3 (a simple notification card with a blank strip; the alert text is lettered, never drawn); from 05-1 on it is put away in the desk drawer and must not appear.

departure.summary: The end of the same visit: Ravi leaves the clinic reassured.
departure.location: Clinic entrance from the street side, morning sun.

costumes.meera: Blue kurta with white churidar, silver bangle on right wrist.

travel.summary: A possible tomorrow: Ravi travels to another Indian city by train. Hypothetical framing ("care may take us beyond our hometown").
travel.location: Indian Railways-style train seat by a window, passing city skyline (no signage).

costumes.ravi: Light green shirt, dark trousers, wristwatch on left wrist.

vision.summary: WELBUK VISION — not a launched feature. A conceptual future of connected clinics, specialists and family wellness, drawn inside a soft pale-blue vignette.
vision.location: Idealised, airy spaces: a modern clinic in another city linked by faint dotted lines to small clinic silhouettes; a family living room. Lighter palette and rounded vignette border.

costumes.ravi: Light green shirt, dark trousers, wristwatch on left wrist.
costumes.specialist: Light grey blazer over a pale blue shirt, rimless glasses, stethoscope worn around his neck (not in use).

objects.family-tablet: Tablet showing an abstract family wellness app: three simple profile circles and a heart icon, no text.

closing.summary: Symbolic closing group portrait in front of the clinic, tying the three Welbuk products to the three people.
closing.location: Clinic entrance with awning and plants, warm morning light.
